prior_reason_rebuttal: Prior verdict called this a 'Duplicate' entry, which was not a real classification. Under the new criteria: read both /services/ and /about/pricelist-and-services/ plus 4 provider bio pages. The full service list is primary care, behavioral health, chronic care management, annual physicals, assisted-living visits, telemedicine, weight-loss program, mental-health/psychiatric services, pain management, and medical-marijuana certification — no skin, injectable, laser, body-contouring, nail or lash service anywhere. Every page carries a 'MEDICAL SPA' nav button, but its href resolves to a different domain (cvillehealthspa.com), a separate sister business, not a service this site itself performs. The /provider/ page's meta description claims staff have 'expertise in Aesthetic Treatments' but no provider bio or service listing names any actual aesthetic treatment.
